findings.explanation: The use case is for Google Cloud Platform monitoring but lists the Splunk Add-on for AWS (Splunkbase 1876) in its references.
findings.suggested_fix: Update references to cite the Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform (Splunkbase 3088, https://splunkbase.splunk.com/app/3088).

findings.explanation: Uses an informal placeholder name instead of the official add-on title 'Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform'.
findings.suggested_fix: Change app to 'Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform'.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: Title specifies 'GCP Cloud API Error Rate Spike' but SPL merely filters raw events with errorCode="*" and tables them without calculating rates, baselines, or spike thresholds.

summary: The use case monitors GCP API errors but erroneously references the Splunk Add-on for AWS (app 1876) instead of the GCP add-on, and the SPL does not calculate an error rate or detect spikes.
